definitions.explanation: The position higher than something else or the upper surface of something.
Can indicate someone older or higher in status.

examples.english: The book is on the desk.

examples.japanese: {上|うえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|うえ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えます→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the town from the top of the mountain.
The cat is sleeping on top of the bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{二|に}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧{上|うえ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My older brother is two years older than me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{上|うえ}⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦にくい→〜にくい：02005_nikui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: She's above me, so it's hard to talk to her.

examples.japanese: {上|うえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦みて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{上|うえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The person one year above me is kind.
You should speak more politely to people who are older than you.

notes:
{上|うえ} indicates position (above/on top), ranking (superior), or age (older).

PRONUNCIATION:
- うえ: kun'yomi (standalone, most compounds)
- じょう: on'yomi (⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧, ⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧)
- かみ: kun'yomi (⟦{川上|かわかみ}→川上：25368_kawakami⟧, ⟦{上|かみ}→上：noentry⟧⟦{半期|はんき}→半期：noentry⟧)

POSITION PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|うえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on top of ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|うえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: on ~, upon ~
- {上|うえ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from above

RANK/STATUS:
- ⟦{目上|めうえ}→目上：03804_meue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: superiors, elders
- ⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧: older (in age)
- ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧: boss, superior

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧: jacket, outer garment
- ⟦{屋上|おくじょう}→屋上：01341_okujou⟧: rooftop
- ⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧: more than, above
- ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: skillful

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: below, under, lower

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {上|うえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上|うえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: There's always someone better
- {上|うえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧: to look up (physically or metaphorically)
